know the difference between average and median packages before making a video

here's an example for you, suppose there are 10 students 1gets 1cr package and the remaining all get 10lpa packages. So the average is the sum of all the packages by the total number of students.

here it is 1.9cr /10=19lpa.
whereas the median is the middle value when the packages are arranged in ascending or descending order.
here the median is 10lpa.
median of nit trichy is 12lpa. the average is around 20lpa.

from this one can deduce if the average is greater than the median then more students have got placed below the average . In the same way, if the median is greater than average then more number of students have been placed more than the average.


this later is not the case usually. Very few students from top branches are able to secure packages more than 20 or25lpa.


As a matter of fact many top nits have average packages more than 10lpa but around 5 have medians above 10lpa!

IITs are autonomous institutions under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. While they do receive some government funding, a significant portion of their operational and infrastructure costs are borne by the students through tuition fees. This is necessary to maintain the high-quality educational standards, research facilities, and faculty at IITs.

In contrast, AIIMS are centrally-funded institutions under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. As premier medical schools, AIIMS receive substantial financial support from the government to keep the tuition fees comparatively lower. The government subsidizes a larger portion of the overall costs at AIIMS, making the student fees more affordable.

comment_text:
The comparison is misleading.

The ₹1.5 Cr figure for a Harvard graduate is simply the ~$175K median starting salary converted at nominal exchange rates. But since you’d be earning and spending in the U.S., purchasing power should be compared using Purchasing Power Parity (PPP), not raw conversion rates.

When adjusted for PPP, IIM Ahmedabad’s ₹36L salary offers a similar standard of living in India as $175K does in the U.S. (Direct conversion of ₹36L in India using a PPP converter - ~$176K)

So, regardless of where you graduate from, your lifestyle tends to align with the local economy - not the currency exchange rate. Ofc, IIMA is no Harvard in terms of prestige and earning in USD will help a lot - but the lifestyle/salary factor is misrepresented here.

Honestly, as it stands today, the biggest problem that works against choosing Harvard is the current situation for immigrants in the US.

​@memansi Hey Memansi, bilkul  main abhi Germany mein MBA kar raha hoon, to yahan ki process aur options pe kaafi clarity hai.

1. University Shortlist:

Munich Business School, Frankfurt School of Finance & Management, ESMT Berlin, Mannheim Business School, ye consistently Germany ke top MBA providers hain.

Program type: Full-time MBA (12–24 months) ya Executive MBA (part-time, 18–24 months). Agar fresh graduate ho, toh full-time jaana better hota hai.


2. Entry Requirements:

Degree: Bachelor’s ya equivalent (minimum 3 saal)

Work Experience: Full-time work experience 2 se 3 saal helpful hoti hai, lekin kuch schools freshers ke liye bhi intakes rakhte hain.

Tests: GMAT (minimum 550 to 600) ya GRE (300+). Kuch schools English proficiency (IELTS 6.5+/TOEFL 90+) bhi maangte hain.


3. Application Timeline:

Rounds: Generally 3 to 4 rounds, pehla Jan–Feb mein, last tak June–July.

Documents: Transcripts, CV, SOP, 2 letters of recommendation, test scores, passport copy.


4. Fees & Funding:

Tuition: €30,000–€40,000 total.

Living Cost: €900–1,200/month (rent + groceries + transport)

Scholarships: DAAD Scholarships, university-specific merit scholarships (up to 50% fee waiver), or Deutschlandstipendium

Student Loan: Indian banks ke education loans yahan cover karte hain — collateral-based & unsecured options available


5. Visa & Work:

Student Visa: Initial 24 months ya program length ke liye

Post-Study Work: Graduation ke baad 18 mahine ka “Job-Seeker Visa” milta hai. Uske andar full-time job search karke Blue Card milta hai


6. Resources & Platforms:

Apply: University websites directly, ya platforms like Study in Germany (study-in-germany.de) se official guidance!

Community: LinkedIn pe “Indian MBA Germany” groups, WhatsApp/Telegram communities se networking shuru kar do aap!


Agar koi specific program ya city me interest ho, batao — exact admission deadlines aur scholarship deadlines share kar dunga!

comment_text:
വിഡിയോയിൽ താങ്കൾ പറഞ്ഞ പല കാര്യങ്ങളോടും യോജിപ്പും അതേപോലെ വിയോജിപ്പുകളും ഉണ്ട്.

പോണ്ടിച്ചേരി യൂണിവേഴ്‌സിറ്റിയിൽ പഠിക്കാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്ന വിദ്യാർത്ഥികൾ അറിയാൻ...

Culture exposure ന് യൂണിവേഴ്‌സിറ്റിയിൽ കാര്യമായ കുറവ് ഉള്ളതായി തോന്നിയട്ടില്ല. (മലയാളികളുടെ എണ്ണം കൂടുതൽ ആണെങ്കിൽ പോലും) , പിന്നീട് മെസിലെ ഫുഡ് average , below average മാത്രമാണ് ഉള്ളത് (girls mess food is better than boys) , ഹോസ്റ്റൽ മുറികളിൽ 3 sharing ആണ്. (ബ്രോ വീഡിയോയിൽ കാണിച്ച ഹോസ്റ്റൽ പുതിയ ഹോസ്റ്റലുകൾ ആണ് അതിൽ 2 sharing rooms ഉണ്ട്) പക്ഷെ ഇവിടെ ഉള്ള ബാക്കി എല്ലാ hostels ഉം 3 sharing ആണ്. (UG & PG) PHD is 2 sharing. 

എല്ലാവർക്കും ഹോസ്റ്റൽ കിട്ടും എന്നത് ശരിയാണ് പക്ഷെ ആദ്യം വരുന്ന കുട്ടികൾക്ക് ആയിരിക്കും rooms കിട്ടാൻ സാധ്യത. കുറച്ച് കുട്ടികൾക്ക് ആദ്യത്തെ സെമസ്റ്ററിൽ hostels ഇലെ dorms ഇൽ നിൽക്കേണ്ടി വന്ന സാഹചര്യം ഈ വർഷങ്ങളിൽ ഉണ്ടായിട്ടുണ്ട്. (99 ശതമാനവും റൂം കിട്ടും) 

Hostel room rent എന്നത് boys നും girlsനും ഒരു വർഷത്തിൽ 900 രൂപ ആണ്. (Girls ന് ഈ വർഷം മുതലാണ് പൈസ വന്നത് , മുമ്പ് സൗജന്യമായിരുന്നു.) മെസ് ഫീസ് ഒരു സെമസ്റ്ററിൽ 10-15k വരും. ഹോസ്റ്റൽ റൂം മാത്രമായി കിട്ടില്ല, മെസും എടുക്കണം. 

പിന്നെ ക്യാമ്പസ് അത്യാവശ്യം vibrant ആണ്. എപ്പോഴും എന്തെങ്കിലും ഒക്കെ പരിപാടികൾ ഉണ്ടാകും. Academics ന്റെ കാര്യത്തിലേക്ക് വന്നാൽ department നോക്കി മാത്രം വരിക. യൂണിവേഴ്‌സിറ്റി കണ്ട് വന്നാൽ നിരാശയാകും. 

ചില department നല്ല acadmeics തരുന്ന department തന്നെയാണ്. യൂണിവേഴ്‌സിറ്റിയിലെ  പല departments നെ കുറിച്ചും മോശം അഭിപ്രായങ്ങൾ കേട്ടിട്ടുണ്ട്. 

നാട്ടിൽ നിന്നും ഇവിടെ എത്താൻ  മലബാർ area ഇൽ ഉള്ളവർക്ക് എല്ലാ വെള്ളിയാഴ്ച യും ഞായറാഴ്ചയും direct ട്രെയിൻ ഉണ്ട്. (16856 - മംഗലാപുരം പുതുച്ചേരി എക്സ്പ്രസ്). കോഴിക്കോട്- ഷൊർണ്ണൂർ- പാലക്കാട് വഴി, കോഴിക്കോട് നിന്ന് K swift ബസും daily സർവീസ് ഉണ്ട്.

തെക്കൻ കേരളത്തിൽ നിന്ന് ആണെങ്കിൽ പോണ്ടിച്ചേരിയിൽ നിന്ന് ഒരു മണിക്കൂർ ദൂരം സഞ്ചരിച്ചാൽ എത്തുന്ന വില്ലുപുരത്തേക്ക് ട്രയിൻ ഉണ്ട്. (അനന്തപുരി എക്സ്പ്രസ്, കൊല്ലം എക്സ്പ്രസ്) , കൂടാതെ തിരുവനന്തപുരത്ത് നിന്ന് തമിഴ്നാട് RTC യുടെ ബസ് daily സർവീസ് ഉണ്ട്, private bus ഉം ഉണ്ട്. 
മധ്യ കേരളത്തിൽ നിന്ന് ആണെകിൽ private buses and  വില്ലുപ്പുരം ട്രെയിൻസ്‌ ഉണ്ട്. 

Campus all over vibe ഉണ്ട് departments നോക്കി വരിക.

comment_text: Honestly the professors are really good at teaching. Regular seminars are also conducted and you get a chance to learn and communicate with foreign professors and archaeologist who visit there. I still remember seeing the excavation process and technical tools demonstrated by UK archaeologist. The professors are very strict, they take attendance very seriously.  There is also a department library. We only got study materials for the 1st semester, for the rest we had to rely on lecture notes that you take and numerous books from the library. There is no one book, you have to go through several books. Also the third year projects are nerve-wracking. Try to think about topics for the project since second year itself and talk to your preferred professor early on or else you will have to settle with whoever is remaining.Overall it a nice and quiet environment. And one more thing, the Archaeology dept. Is not fun unlike the others. During my time, the only fun activity was freshers and farewell. I used to go to other facilities for trips, competitions and other activities. You wouldn't hear a sound in our dept. 😂 Academically it is very nice. If you have any doubts feel free to ask me.

यूनिवर्सिटी की वेबसाइट पर जो प्लेसमेंट आंकड़े दिखाए जाते हैं, वे सरकारी NIRF रिपोर्ट में दिए गए आंकड़ों से मेल नहीं खाते। जब आप सीधे फोन करके डिटेल प्लेसमेंट लिस्ट मांगते हैं — जैसे किस कंपनी में कितने स्टूडेंट्स लगे, किसको कितना पैकेज मिला — तो स्पष्ट और लिखित जानकारी देने से बचा जाता है।
बीटेक कंप्यूटर साइंस में 15–17 लाख रुपये तक की फीस (हॉस्टल अलग से) खर्च करने के बाद अगर औसत पैकेज लगभग 4–5 लाख रुपये सालाना ही मिले, तो यह हर माता-पिता और छात्र को गंभीरता से सोचने की जरूरत है। इतनी बड़ी फीस के मुकाबले ROI (Return on Investment) बहुत कम दिखाई देता है।
कई छात्रों का यह भी कहना है कि यहां पढ़ाई से ज्यादा फोकस इवेंट्स, फंक्शन और शो पर रहता है। बड़े-बड़े विज्ञापन, यूट्यूब प्रमोशन और चमकदार कैंपस दिखाकर छात्रों को आकर्षित किया जाता है, लेकिन असली सवाल प्लेसमेंट की गुणवत्ता और पारदर्शिता का है।
मेरे भारतवासियों से निवेदन है —
सिर्फ विज्ञापन देखकर या बड़े नाम से प्रभावित होकर एडमिशन मत लीजिए।
✔ ऐसी यूनिवर्सिटी चुनिए जहां:
प्लेसमेंट डेटा पूरी तरह पारदर्शी हो
कंपनी-वाइज लिस्ट उपलब्ध हो
फीस वाजिब हो
औसत पैकेज और फीस में संतुलन हो
माता-पिता की मेहनत की कमाई बहुत कीमती होती है। 15–20 लाख खर्च करने से पहले 10 बार सोचिए। बड़ी यूनिवर्सिटी का नाम हमेशा बड़ी सफलता की गारंटी नहीं होता।

B.Tech has more value in the long run, better job opportunities & higher salary growth, but it can be costly if not planned properly. BCA is a good option if you are interested in coding, software & want a relatively affordable degree, but you may need MCA later for better growth.

You should first focus on:
• Affordable colleges (government or low-fee private)
• Scholarships, education loans & entrance exams
• Your interest in coding vs core engineering subjects

Don’t feel heartbroken. With the right planning, both paths can work. Choose what matches your interest, budget & future goals.

1. स्कॉलरशिप परीक्षा का झांसा
      दोनों विश्वविद्यालय (एलपीयू और चंडीगढ़ यूनिवर्सिटी) ₹1000 की फीस लेकर स्कॉलरशिप परीक्षा आयोजित करते हैं।
2. 30% से अधिक स्कॉलरशिप नहीं
      चाहे छात्र ऑनलाइन पेपर अच्छा दे या बुरा, औसतन सभी को 30% या उससे कम स्कॉलरशिप ही मिलती है। किसी को 30% से अधिक नहीं दी जाती।
3. गणित साफ है
      एलपीयू में 40,000 से अधिक छात्र हैं।
      यदि प्रत्येक से ₹1000 लिए जाते हैं, तो कुल कमाई = ₹4 करोड़ (40,000 × 1000)।
4. स्कॉलरशिप के नाम पर यूनिवर्सिटी का खर्च
      इस तरह स्कॉलरशिप की फीस से ही विश्वविद्यालय का संचालन हो जाता है। छात्रों को औसतन केवल 25-30% स्कॉलरशिप मिलती है, बाकी पैसा यूनिवर्सिटी की आमदनी होती है।

      यही स्कैम देशभर के कई निजी विश्वविद्यालयों में चल रहा है। स्कॉलरशिप के नाम पर छात्रों से पैसे वसूले जाते हैं।
6. दाखिले के बाद और फीस
      एक बार कॉलेज में दाखिला हो जाने के बाद, प्लेसमेंट फीस, एग्जाम फीस, और तरह-तरह की अन्य फीस वसूली जाती है। यह “भारत फीस” जैसे नामों से भी ली जाती है।
7. यूट्यूब पर प्रचार से बचें

video_title: VIT Vellore Fees 2025 | Full Breakdown for BTech & Hostel
comment_text:
Phases are the slot in which students get seat allotment. 
Rank 1 to 20000 - Phase 1
Rank 20001 to 40000 - Phase 2
Rank 40001 to 60000 - Phase 3
and so on.

Category is for fees 
Cat 1 - 2L
Cat 2 - 3L
Cat 3 - 4L
Cat 4 - 4.5L
Cat 5 - 5L

So if your rank is 50k, you will be given phase 3, which means your choice filling will start after phase 1 and phase 2 are over. And with 50k, you can get into certain CSE Specialization in Chennai campus in higher category, and maybe even get into Vellore campus good branch but in higher Category (means higher fees).

Placement wali cheez totally depends on you.

4.It's a great option if you only want to study CSE and are getting 30% above scholarship.Also if you are not getting your favoured branch at Govt colleges.

comment_text: @riddhibhalerao2652 Look, the hostel situation here is like this  they have limited seats, whether it’s girls’ hostel or boys’ hostel. So they usually give more preference to first year students compared to second year students. If you’re in first year, you’ll most likely get a hostel for sure. If you’re in second year, you can still get it, but if you apply late, it might already be full. Also, the on campus hostel isn’t that great. It’s pretty old from the inside and doesn’t have many facilities. For example, it costs around ₹2 lakh for triple sharing, with a common washroom and no AC. On the other hand, if you look outside, there are a lot of hostels nearby. Honestly, I’d recommend going for those. Within like 250–300 meters or just a 5 minute walk, you’ll find plenty of options and the best part is, for around ₹1.8 to ₹2 lakh, you can get much better facilities AC, geyser, attached washroom, and properly furnished rooms.

Final Year Student Review – Overall Not Recommended

01. Hostels: 2.5/5
A: Showers often stop working mid-use; once got stuck in the toilet during a water outage.

02. Mess: 1/5
A: Very poor food quality. Typically two curries, roti, rice, and a watery sweet dish. During monsoon, insects and even a frog were reportedly found in the food.

03. Transport: 3/5
A: Initially provided buses to classes, but services were later discontinued.

04. Classrooms: 4/5
A: Seats are all on the same level; should be tiered for better visibility. New campuses have this, most older ones don’t.

05. Dating: 5/5
A: No restrictions. Around 30% of students find partners here.

06. Freedom: 5/5
A: Full freedom. Unlimited Wi-Fi and no surveillance.

07. Care: 5/5
A: Wardens are caring and attentive, even toward introverts. Mentors are helpful.

08. Faculties: 1/5
A: Teaching quality is poor; most just read directly from PowerPoint slides.

09. Hygiene: 1/5
A: Strong gutter smell and unhygienic street food around the campus.

10. Management: 1/5
A: Despite having biometric attendance, they still rely on outdated paper logs for hostel entry and exit.

Overall Verdict: Not recommended

First, get your facts right before accusing someone of “misguiding.” I never said PGDM is bad. I clearly mentioned that PGDM from IIMs or top-tier institutes is excellent—but that doesn’t mean every PGDM is better than an MBA.

Most IIMs offer PGDM because they’re autonomous and legally can’t offer an MBA degree. That doesn’t make PGDM better—it just makes it different. On the other hand, MBA is a university-recognized degree, and when it comes from reputed names like NMIMS or Symbiosis (especially in online mode for working professionals), it carries solid value and better ROI.

So no, doing MBA doesn’t mean I’m calling PGDM bad—it just means I know the difference and I talk facts, not emotions.

😮😮There are lot of issues in NMIMS Hostel. It is outsourced to Royal Homes. 

1. They do not do fresh painting of rooms before onboarding of new inmates in hostel

2. There are multiple issues of pest control...Lizards, Mosquitoes thrive in hostel rooms, common areas

3. Food is so so pathetic. Inspite of charging heavy money, food is so bad. There have been multiple complaints regarding cockroaches in food and students getting ill.

3. Inspite of charging Rs 270,000 demanded in advance for 10 months, there is no AC in rooms. Bengaluru weather is hot at times and inspite of paying such high amount, its not acceptable of No AC room.

4. They harass inmates by holding security deposit...They raise frivilous allegation of damage to walls. Inspite of no fresh paint job before onboarding, they demand money for full room paint of 11000 from students for full room painting during exiting of the hostel. Normally students exit hostels after first year and move to PG since its so bad and very expensive.Even its so much regulated that even coming after 8.30pm, the caretaker calls up parents. Its over controlled by mgmt.

Very unprofessional and Unethical practices followed by Nmims Hostel Bengaluru. First not getting room painted before new session. Then frivilous allegation of wall damage and thwn asking for Rs 11000 for full Room paint job. Think of it allegation of one wall converts into full room painting penalty. Basically bogus practise to hold security deposit and not return back money by some or the other wall damage allegations.

Genuine feedback from parent of student in Nmims bengaluru Hostel. All new students and parents, pls beware and note before taking decision.

Nmims hostel mngt is complete disaster n unprofessional...they grab your security deposit by harassing students n parents...think 10 times before onboarding in nmims hostel

Graphic Era University’s so-called Scholarship Exam *GECET* is a complete scam – BEWARE!

Let me save you of the trouble you are heading yourself into if thinking of taking admission in this university and tell you straight: Graphic Era University’s scholarship exam is an absolute joke and a disgusting money-making scam. They lure students with flashy promises of "up to 100% scholarships" and create this whole image of being a supportive, merit-based institution. But the truth? It’s just a clever way for them to loot ₹1500 from thousands of students with zero intention of actually awarding anything to anyone.

I paid the ₹1500 registration fee, studied seriously, and took the exam with full hope. But guess what? The exam was scheduled on 20th April and the results were released on 4th May which stated I have not qualified..how stupid..who fails in an online proctored exam right!!.If not a full scholarship, at least 70–80% should be justified. It's hard to believe anyone would be considered not qualified—it feels like they just don’t want to give it at all.

How is that even fair or professional? Above all this is the audacity to tell the candidate to re-appear for the exam in the next phase by paying another 1500 and making a fool out of themselves. It’s obvious this is just a cash-grab operation. 

Honestly, it’s shameful that a university claiming to be “prestigious” is running such a shady scheme. If they can deceive students before admission, imagine what else they’ll lie about after you join. If this is how they treat students who haven’t even enrolled yet, I can’t even imagine the mess they make once you’re trapped inside.

My advice: stay FAR away from Graphic Era University. There are plenty of other colleges that are honest, transparent, and actually care about students. Don’t fall for the fake promises and shiny ads — this place is all about money, not education.

To the university: Stop calling yourself “Graphic Era” and start calling yourself “Loot Era.” At least then people will know what they’re getting into.

comment_text: DO not join IIIT LUCKNOW in order to join you will need 99% in JEE main. I joined last year with 98.9% in OBC. This college is a nightmare with no basic amenities, hostels with 10-15 students in a dorm, no proper labs, classrooms, library, inadequate number of teachers, rampant ragging. Because of this situation, I had to take a drop. Trust me, when you visit the college website, you will see boasting 100% placement, all the facilities, pictures of convocation with the president – it’s all half-baked truth. many of my friends are still suffering and living with regret. If you want to join this college, before college, I request you to go to Lucknow, see that place for what it is, and then decide; otherwise, you will waste crucial time of your life like me and regret other opportunities that you could have taken. My suggestion: go with a top NIT ECE or CS in a lower NIT; trust me, you will not regret it. Do share this message in your friends’ group.”

comment_text:
Worst college. I repeat, worst college to join. Don’t ever come here.

80% attendance rule. Disciplinary action for little things. No night campus culture. Still have to take outpass for going out and have to return by 7 PM.

Have to go to hostel by 9:30 PM. They don’t allow students to play games outside the hostel after 9:40 PM.

Hostel rooms have metal mesh in the balcony so that students cannot look out.

Worst mess food. You will pay mess fees for food but cannot eat there. Zomato is the option.

Worst management. Director and registrar are the worst. They don’t give funds for student projects, fests, and other events.

Faculties are very strict about attendance. If you fall below the 80% attendance mark, they collect ₹1000 for every 1% shortage.

Fake placement report. There were only 30% placements, but they are claiming 100%. No core placements.

Very, very poor college.

If you want good placements, a memorable college life, and a strong alumni base, then please avoid this college.

As a student/victim of this college with 95 percentile in JEE, I am saying this.

They care only about professors and their research groups.

Unlike legacy NITs or IITs that receive massive, continuous direct financial subsidies from the Central Government to cover operational expenses, PPP IIITs are established through a joint venture. The capital is split between the Central Government, the State Government, and private industry partners.

बिट्स पिलानी और मैसाचुसेट्स इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ टेक्नोलॉजी (MIT) की तुलना करें तो यह स्पष्ट होता है कि शोध, नवाचार और वैश्विक प्रभाव के मामले में बिट्स बहुत पीछे है। MIT लगातार QS और THE (Times Higher Education) रैंकिंग में टॉप 5 में बना रहता है, जबकि बिट्स पिलानी 800-1000 की रैंकिंग में आता है। शोध और गुणवत्ता के मामले में भी MIT बहुत आगे है, जिसके 100 से अधिक नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता हैं, जबकि बिट्स से अभी तक कोई भी वैज्ञानिक इस स्तर तक नहीं पहुंच पाया है। पेटेंट और औद्योगिक नवाचारों में भी MIT हर साल हजारों पेटेंट फाइल करता है, जबकि बिट्स इस मामले में बहुत पीछे है। IITs फिर भी किसी हद तक वैश्विक स्तर पर अपनी पहचान बना रहे हैं, लेकिन बिट्स पिलानी जैसे संस्थानों की स्थिति और भी कमजोर है।

यह और भी शर्मनाक तब हो जाता है जब तथाकथित "मेरिट" का रोना रोने वाले लोग शिक्षा प्रणाली में मौजूद अन्याय को नजरअंदाज करते हैं। बिट्स पिलानी में एडमिशन के लिए 24-25 लाख रुपए की भारी-भरकम फीस और इसके पहले कोचिंग संस्थानों में लाखों रुपए बर्बाद करने के बावजूद भी यह संस्थान MIT से कोसों दूर है। यह वही "अंगूठा काटो" नीति है, जिसमें सिर्फ पैसे और संसाधनों तक सीमित लोगों को ही आगे बढ़ने का मौका दिया जाता है, जबकि भारत की अधिकांश जनता को उच्च शिक्षा से बाहर कर दिया जाता है। MIT जैसे संस्थान जहाँ स्कॉलरशिप और रिसर्च फंडिंग से प्रतिभाओं को बढ़ावा देते हैं, वहीं भारत में महंगी फीस और कोचिंग इंडस्ट्री का जाल अधिकांश योग्य छात्रों को आगे बढ़ने से रोक देता है। ऐसी व्यवस्था पर गर्व करने वालों को यह सोचना चाहिए कि जब इतने संसाधनों और अवसरों के बाद भी बिट्स पिलानी MIT से इतना पीछे है, तो यह "मेरिट" की जीत नहीं बल्कि एक असफलता की कहानी है।

Guys, I'm a BITSian, studying in this campus right now. I love Yatharth's content and all, but do your proper research before joining. Bits is overhyped, it's not as good in terms of campus life. For placements it's great, but facilities have to be improved by a ton. Especially the SAC, hostels (terrible washrooms), no ACs in hostel rooms (you'll understand why in the second sem), and some sports facilities can be improved. 

All I'm saying is that you should probably visit the campus and then make your decision. I was not ready to be disappointed, but some are still happy with this. 

Good luck!

comment_text:
I am a B.Pharm graduate from BIT Mesra. Based on my experience, I do not recommend taking admission to this college, as I found it to be a poor return on investment. I spent around 16 lakhs in fees, but the college did not bring a single company for campus placements in my course. This issue is not limited to B.Pharm-other courses also face similar placement challenges. The placement brochure and NAAC accreditation do not reflect the actual situation, and I found them to be of little value.

The college seems more focused on collecting money, often imposing heavy fines, rather than supporting students' futures. In my opinion, spending 15–18 lakhs here is not justified, especially when you can complete your course at a reputable college for 6–8 lakhs. The so-called fame of BIT Mesra is also overrated in regions like North and West India, most people confuse BIT Mesra with BITS Pilani and are not aware of this institution.

My honest advice is to consider other colleges that offer better value for your money and genuine placement support.
